diagnosis.text: DIAGNOSIS: The `dismiss_after_tap` coordinate (200, 200) accidentally hits the "DAILY SPECIAL OFFERS" tab in the Underground Offers left sidebar after the final claim, silently switching away from LST Hunt before OCR runs — so OCR reads the wrong screen and finds 0 cooldown timers; the "unknown" failure reason is the dashboard rendering `reason: null` (only populated on real errors) as `'unknown'` on what was actually a successful 3-claim run.
